body_lead: BENGALURU: At a time when there is a shortage of over 50,000 teachers in government schools and children lacking basic learning in major subjects, the government has decided to implement Artificial Intelligence to teach students Math, English and Kannada. As per the government order, an MoU was signed between Samagra Shikshana Karnataka and Ek Step Foundation in Bengaluru to help class 4 to 6 students enhance their learning skills in government schools across the state.
